column1: # Advance widths (font units) of every BMP character in the cmap of MS PMincho (msmincho.ttc) and MS PGothic (msgothic.ttc), read from hmtx with struct.

# Each section starts with "@font <name> <upem>"; then one line per run of consecutive code points with the same advance: <first hex>[-<last hex>][<TAB><advance>]; a line with no advance is the em (the upem, 256), which most characters have.
# The two fonts have no kern table and the GPOS only has mark features (no kern, palt, halt, chws): the advance is the whole story for a plain run.
